SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID totalTradeId, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T1.SETTLE_DATE settleDate, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T2.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T1.PS ps, T1.SHARE_AMT settleNumT, T1.TRADE_AMT settleAmtT, case when T9.PS = #{feePs02} and T9.SETTLE_STATUS = #{settlementStatus01} and T9.ORDER_RET_STATUS = #{commandDealStatus01} THEN #{cleanStatus01} when T9.PS = #{feePs02} and T9.SETTLE_STATUS = #{settlementStatus01} and T9.ORDER_RET_STATUS = #{commandDealStatus02} THEN #{cleanStatus02} when T9.PS = #{feePs02} and (T9.SETTLE_STATUS is null or T9.SETTLE_STATUS = #{settlementStatus02}) and T9.ORDER_RET_STATUS = '03' THEN #{cleanStatus03} ELSE NULL END cleanStatus, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T1.TRADE_PLAT tradePlat, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secAcctId, T8.SETTLE_SEQ_NO settleSeqNo, T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE tgBusiType, T3.TRADE_ID tradeId, T3.SHARE_AMT settleNum, T3.TRADE_AMT settleAmt, T4.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId
FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T4 ON T3.TRADE_ID = T4.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO T8 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T8.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_PAY_ORDERS T9 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T9.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN INF_PAY_ORDERS_STATUS T10 ON T9.ORDER_ID = T10.ORDER_ID WHERE (T8.SETTLE_SEQ_NO IS NULL OR T8.SETTLE_STATUS = #{DELIVERY_STATUS_01}) AND T1.TG_BUSI_TYPE IN (#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_09},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_10},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_11}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_35},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_36},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_36}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_20},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_51},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_52}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_74},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_75},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_76},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_77}, #{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_105},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_106},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_107},#{PINAN_BUSINESS_TYPE_108}) AND T1.TRADE_STATUS =#{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND T1.Is_Cancel =#{isCalcY} AND T1.SETTLE_DATE = #{batchDate}
mapper.delete: delete from TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_FLOW WHERE SETTLE_SEQ_NO IN (SELECT SETTLE_SEQ_NO FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO WHERE SETTLE_DATE= #{batchDate} AND CREATE_USER = #{createrUser})
delete from TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SET_DETAIL WHERE SETTLE_SEQ_NO IN (SELECT SETTLE_SEQ_NO FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO WHERE SETTLE_DATE= #{batchDate} AND CREATE_USER = #{createrUser})
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO tbms USING ( select
#{settleSeqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleSeqNo,
#{settleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} settleStatus,
#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} tradeId,
#{settleDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} settleDate,
#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} finprodId,
#{settleNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleNum,
#{settleAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} settleAmt,
#{busiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} busiType,
#{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createUser,
#{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} createDept,
#{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} createTime,
#{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} updateUser,
#{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} updateTime
from dual ) TEMP
ON (tbms.SETTLE_SEQ_NO = TEMP.settleSeqNo)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
tbms.SETTLE_STATUS = TEMP.settleStatus,
tbms.TRADE_ID = TEMP.tradeId,
tbms.SETTLE_DATE = TEMP.settleDate,
tbms.FINPROD_ID = TEMP.finprodId,
tbms.SETTLE_NUM = TEMP.settleNum,
tbms.SETTLE_AMT = TEMP.settleAmt,
tbms.BUSI_TYPE = TEMP.busiType,
tbms.CREATE_USER = TEMP.createUser,
tbms.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.createDept,
tbms.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.createTime,
tbms.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.updateUser,
tbms.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.updateTime
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
SETTLE_SEQ_NO
,SETTLE_STATUS
,TRADE_ID
,SETTLE_DATE
,FINPROD_ID
,SETTLE_NUM
,SETTLE_AMT
,BUSI_TYPE
,CREATE_USER
,CREATE_DEPT
,CREATE_TIME
,UPDATE_USER
,UPDATE_TIME
) values(
TEMP.settleSeqNo
,TEMP.settleStatus
,TEMP.tradeId
,TEMP.settleDate
,TEMP.finprodId
,TEMP.settleNum
,TEMP.settleAmt
,TEMP.busiType
,TEMP.createUser
,TEMP.createDept
,TEMP.createTime
,TEMP.updateUser
,TEMP.updateTime
)
